selection_policy: Choose the lowest-priority-number incomplete work package. If blocked, produce dependency checklist instead of claiming execution.

work_packages.title: Establish persistent GitHub state and daily workset generator
work_packages.summary: Create the repository control layer that replaces long scheduled-task prompts with persistent state and deterministic daily work orders.
acceptance_criteria: State JSON files exist for project, queue, QA, release, and pipeline status.
A validation script verifies required state files and unique work package IDs.
A daily workset script produces dated JSON and Markdown outputs.
A GitHub Actions workflow can run validation and generate the workset artifact without committing changes.

work_packages.title: Verify credential-backed OpenAI TTS assets
work_packages.summary: Execute a two-slide live TTS pilot only after an approved request queue and OPENAI_API_KEY are present in the runner.
acceptance_criteria: Two authentic narration MP3 files decode successfully.
Every asset maps to one stable slide_id and one frozen request fingerprint.
No credentials appear in artifacts or logs.
Request identifiers, model, voice, timestamp, bytes, checksum, codec, and duration are recorded.
Human review passes pronunciation, intelligibility, pacing, and terminology.
Only verified audio assets enter the binding manifest.
blockers: OpenAI authenticated probe failed with invalid_api_key; replace the local OPENAI_API_KEY and rerun scripts/openai_tts_live_pilot.py --live.
No authentic MP3 assets exist for codec, checksum, duration, loudness, silence, or clipping analysis.

work_packages.title: Integrate Nurse Prep EB web app cockpit
work_packages.summary: Add a dependency-free operations web app that renders the repository's persistent state, QA gates, TTS pilot status, daily workset, and artifact map.
acceptance_criteria: The app renders active work package, blockers, QA gates, runtime status, and artifact outputs.
The app reads committed repository JSON when served from the repository root.
The app includes embedded fallback state when JSON fetches are unavailable.
A validation script verifies referenced app files and required data-source paths.
GitHub Actions validates the app with the daily workset checks.

work_packages.title: Integrate OpenAI TTS production pilot telemetry
work_packages.owner: Codex + Build Web Apps + OpenAI Developers
work_packages.summary: Connect the Nurse Prep EB Workbench to the source-grounded production pilot, including live OpenAI MP3 evidence, lesson spec, source manifest, binding manifest, release blockers, and validation checks.
acceptance_criteria: The app renders production pilot status, source grounding, slide count, source count, verified audio count, and binding readiness.
The app lists per-slide verified OpenAI audio assets without exposing credentials.
The app surfaces external playback blockers separately from completed audio generation.
The validator requires production pilot data-source paths, DOM targets, and committed pilot artifacts.
Documentation identifies the integrated OpenAI TTS pilot artifacts.

work_packages.title: Create production pilot playback evidence gate
work_packages.summary: Add a machine-readable playback evidence template, validator, blocked report, and dashboard integration so downstream release review can capture browser, LMS, PowerPoint, or Google Slides playback evidence against exact artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Playback evidence has a reusable JSON template.
A validator blocks release until a release path, final artifact checksum, required target players, and playback records are present.
The production pilot release report consumes playback evidence status.
The Nurse Prep EB Workbench surfaces playback gate blockers.
No credential or bearer material can appear in playback evidence.

work_packages.title: Run an end-to-end source-grounded production lesson pilot
work_packages.summary: Run a two-to-five-slide nursing lesson through lesson spec, narration, audio, video/deck binding, machine QA, and playback evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Each slide has stable slide_id, speaker notes, TTS text, and source references.
One verified MP3 maps to each narrated slide.
Captions match approved TTS text.
Machine QA passes.
Browser or LMS playback evidence references the exact final artifact checksum.
No blocker or major defects remain.
blockers: ffmpeg/ffprobe not available, so MP4 assembly and stream QA were not executed.
Release playback path has not been selected.
Final artifact path and checksum are not recorded.
No target-player playback records are recorded.
outputs: Production source package has not been selected.
Live OpenAI narration is not yet verified.
Target playback environment has not been selected.

work_packages.title: SkillBridge enterprise integration and API framework
work_packages.summary: Continue the SkillBridge systems integration sequence with OpenAPI, event contracts, webhook contracts, MDM, and integration testing strategy.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAPI 3.1 draft exists for core registry and workflow resources.
Event contracts preserve correlation_id and schema_version.
Make/n8n orchestration boundaries are documented.
FHIR alignment is assessed only where applicable.
Production blockers remain clearly separated from prototype tasks.
blockers: Implementation platform and identity provider are not selected.
Authoritative policy source verification remains incomplete.
